headline.purpose: The title of a client page: Home wordmark, services, service detail, booking, checkout.

title.purpose: The title of an error, invalid-link or payment-progress state, and of admin pages such as bookings.

section.purpose: Every h2, card section title and fieldset legend (a legend takes the heading font by hand, and drops to 1rem inside a card that has its own h2).

body.purpose: Almost all text; inputs are 1rem on phones.

reference.purpose: Booking and payment reference numbers: monospace, semibold, wide tracking.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: The resting shadow of every card, with a 1px Hairline Blue border.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on buttons, inputs, checkboxes and badges; the control border turns full Calendar Blue.

shadows.name: link-focus-outline
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on a standalone text link; full strength because a 50% ring is only about 1.9:1 on the page.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Tailwind default easing for state transitions.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Tailwind default: hover, focus and press on buttons and inputs.

motion.name: duration-status
motion.purpose: The status dot colour change; off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: press-nudge
motion.purpose: A pressed button moves down one pixel.

breakpoints.name: pointer-coarse
breakpoints.purpose: Input modality: controls grow to 44px on touch, stay 32px otherwise.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen: Available Green, white label, darkens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{box-sizing:border-box;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius, 0.5rem);font:500 14px/20px 'Open Sans Variable', 'Open Sans', sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);outline:none;background:var(--primary, oklch(0.5081 0.1049 165.61));color:var(--primary-foreground, oklch(1 0 0));}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.5081 0.1049 165.61)), black 12%);}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{border-color:var(--ring, oklch(0.5876 0.1389 241.97));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.5876 0.1389 241.97)) 50%, transparent);}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px);}

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quieter action beside a primary one: white fill, a slate edge like a text field, Powder Blue on hover.

narrative.overview:
Bookly should feel like the front desk of a well-run studio: someone calm at the counter who tells you plainly what is free, what you owe and when, and never oversells. The surfaces stay quiet (a sky-tinted page, white cards with a hairline edge and a whisper of shadow) so that the things that matter, a time, an amount, a status word, are the loudest thing on the screen. Colour appears only when it means something, and it is never the only carrier of meaning.

One system serves two people. Clients book on a phone or a laptop, with no account, usually once. The photographer runs the business from the admin on a desktop. Both get the same tokens and the same primitives; the admin is denser (the low end of the spacing scale), never different in kind. The feel is calm and exact: precise numbers, plain labels, no flourish. Decoration is non-textual (an icon or a dot beside words that already say the thing) and stays small.

Visual rejections recorded in the design system (`design-system/bookly/MASTER.md` section 2; the first three are also enforced by Impeccable's design hook): no gradient text, no glow shadows, no coloured left-edge stripes, no modals, no 3D, parallax or scroll-driven effects, no emoji as icons. The theme is light only; the `.dark` block in `index.css` is unreachable and undesigned.

The palette and the type pairing were chosen by a design tool and accepted by the user. The client has supplied no logo or brand colours yet, so nothing here is brand-derived. If brand colours arrive, they replace Available Green and Calendar Blue in `frontend/src/index.css` and nothing else changes.
keyCharacteristics: Sky-tinted page, white cards, one green for the next step, one blue for focus.
Poppins for headings, Open Sans for everything else, both self-hosted.
32px controls on a mouse, 44px on touch.
Hairline borders plus `shadow-sm`; no heavy shadows.
Every status and every amount is written in words; colour and icons only repeat them.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Available Green marks the next step and the confirmed state, and nothing else. It is never decoration, and never the fill of a status that is not confirmed.

rules.name: The Blue Is For Looking Rule
rules.body: Calendar Blue is focus and information. As text on white it is only 4.10:1, so blue text uses #0369A1 (5.93:1); the plain brand blue is for outlines and rings.

rules.name: The Words Come First Rule
rules.body: Colour never carries a meaning alone. A status dot, a tint or an icon always sits beside the words that state the same thing.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Poppins speaks only in `h1`, `h2`, `h3`, card titles and fieldset legends: the headings get it once from the base layer of `index.css`, and a legend, which is a heading inside a form, adds `font-heading` itself. Everything else is Open Sans.

rules.name: The Numbers Stay Put Rule
rules.body: Amounts, times and counts use tabular figures so columns and totals do not shift as digits change.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: A card's edge is a 1px border plus `shadow-sm` and nothing heavier. The one clickable card, a service on the list, lifts to `shadow-md` on hover as its affordance. Extra separation comes from tone (white on sky), never from a bigger shadow.

dos: **Do** write every status, amount and time in words; let a dot, tint or icon only repeat them.
**Do** keep controls 32px on a mouse and 44px under `pointer-coarse:`.
**Do** put keyboard focus in Calendar Blue: a 3px ring at 50% plus a full-strength border on controls, and a 2px full-strength outline offset 2px on text links and on a bare native checkbox.
**Do** set `aria-disabled` on a busy control instead of `disabled`, and fade it to 50%.
**Do** put unpredictable text (errors, names, references) in a shrinkable child with `min-w-0 wrap-anywhere`.
**Do** use tabular figures for amounts and times, and monospace semibold for references.
**Do** reuse existing strings; new decoration is an icon, a dot or a border, not new copy.
**Do** keep icons to lucide, outline style, with `aria-hidden="true"` when they sit beside words.
donts: **Don't** use gradient text, glow shadows or a one-sided coloured stripe on a card or callout; they are ruled out in `MASTER.md` section 2 and flagged by Impeccable's design hook.
**Don't** add modals, 3D, parallax, scroll-driven effects, or emoji icons. (Public pages gained a shared header and footer on 2026-09-21, at the user's request; that is no longer a rejection.)
**Don't** use white text on the lighter #059669 green (3.77:1), and don't let a hover state lighten the default Button.
**Don't** set text in the plain Calendar Blue on white (4.10:1); use #0369A1.
**Don't** use Hairline Blue or Powder Blue as the only boundary of a control or as the only signal of state.
**Don't** show a green icon, tick or tint for anything the API has not confirmed: waiting, received-but-unconfirmed and refund views are blue.
**Don't** hard-code a colour, radius or font in a component; use the tokens in `index.css`.
**Don't** use `bg-input/…` for a disabled fill (the input token is now a mid slate); use Powder Blue.
